verdict.rationale: Loops' homepage claims you can "see which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue," which is a first-party claim of email-to-revenue attribution beyond opens and clicks. It is only a single marketing line, with no docs explaining how attribution works, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of conversion/goal tracking and revenue attribution mechanics, signup attribution per email or workflow, attribution reporting UI or API details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
